meaning.en: TIS 166 socket (Type O, Thailand), shown as the socket face seen from the front, earth hole up
meaning.de: TIS-166-Steckdose (Typ O, Thailand), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn, Schutzkontakt oben

standard.source: TIS 166-2549 not consulted; contact layout taken from the OpenPlugDB front view "TIS 166 socket-outlet (female), mating face, earth hole up" (https://github.com/ovarilo/openplugdb/blob/main/public/images/connectors/tis-166/socket-front.svg, retrieved 2026-11-08), drawn from Thai Industrial Standards Institute (TISI), published by Public.Resource.Org "TIS 166-2549: Plugs and socket-outlets for household and similar purposes: plugs and socket-outlets with rated voltage not exceeding 250 V" (https://archive.org/details/th.cs.166.t.2549, retrieved 2026-11-08)
